verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Adyen Issuing can create virtual and physical cards (docs-1) and manage/activate them via API (docs-10, docs-15), but there is no evidence of a single API call returning PAN/CVV/expiry instantly, nor any mention of self-serve sandbox-to-live onboarding without a sales process — onboarding language (docs-26) implies a KYC/partnership process rather than instant self-service. missing for 10: single-call card creation with immediate PAN/CVV/expiry in response, explicit self-service go-live flow without sales engagement, independent confirmation of no sales cycle.
